text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Super Creek bakes a huge batch of madeleines to give to her friends.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe! You're welcome.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: But… I'm in a bit of a pickle.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I made some for myself as well, but I spent so much time handing them out that it's already really late…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I can't be eating sweets at this hour… But still…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Do you think it would be okay for me to have some? Just a few.
choice_data_list: Don't give in to the temptation…
How about giving them to someone else?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Okay, then just a few!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I actually had a taste, and they were quite delicious, so I've been looking forward to having some more!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I'll work extra hard at training tomorrow to make up for it. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Super Creek hums a tune as she makes some tea and enjoys her madeleines.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: O-okay, then here I go.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: You know, I've been looking forward to eating them since I was baking. Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh, I'll make some tea while I'm at it. Would you like some too?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Super Creek hums to herself as she makes some tea and happily digs into her madeleines.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Ack… You're right…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'll save them for tomorrow morning or something.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Fight the urge, fight the urge!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Super Creek squeezes her eyes shut and stops herself from eating the madeleines.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh! Come to think of it… Oguri looked like she wanted more when I gave her some earlier.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I'll have her eat my share.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Mmm… I can't wait to see her stuff her face.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Super Creek enjoys watching Oguri Cap munch on the madeleines.
